issues: On Evolve is incorrectly encoded as dealDamage to exactly 2 enemy followers; it should be able to select up to 2 enemy followers and deal 5 damage to each. Encode this as a multi-target damage effect with 0-2 or up-to-2 selection if supported; otherwise implement engine support for optional/up-to target counts on enemyFollower targeting or a dedicated up-to-N multi-target damage operation.

The first fanfare cost is incorrectly encoded as discard exactly 3 cards; it should be discard up to 3 cards. Encode the discard as optional/up-to-3 if supported; otherwise implement engine support for optional variable discard counts.

The first fanfare checks are incorrectly keyed off discardedCardType:follower three times; they should separately check whether at least 1 discarded card had trait Cute, Cool, and Passion, then apply heal 2, draw 1, and deal 2 damage to each enemy leader respectively. Encode with discarded-trait conditions if supported; otherwise implement conditions for checking discarded card traits this effect/turn.

The Passion payoff is incorrectly encoded as dealDamageAllEnemies 2; it should deal 2 damage to each enemy leader. Encode as damage to all enemy leaders if supported; otherwise implement an effect that damages each opponent leader.
The fanfare is missing 'Lesson (1)' before the deck look effect. Encode the Lesson (1) requirement/cost if supported; otherwise implement engine support for Lesson/N counters or payments.
Fanfare search filter is too narrow: the card says you may put one of the top 5 cards into your EX area, not only a Beast card. Encode searchDeckChoose without the Beast filter.

The play cost reduction condition is incorrect: it should apply only if the chosen card is a Beast follower that costs 4 or less. Encode the EX-area placement with a conditional reduction restricted to Beast follower and maxCost 4, not unconditional reduction on any chosen Beast card.

On Evolve is encoded as generic damageImmunity, but the text is specifically 'this follower doesn't take combat damage' for the rest of this turn. Encode combat-damage-only immunity if supported; otherwise implement engine support for temporary combat damage immunity distinct from ability damage immunity.

The fanfare bury cost is encoded as buryFieldFollowers, which would bury all matching Levin followers; it should bury exactly one other Levin follower you choose. Encode the cost as a single selected selfFollower with trait Levin and excludeSelf true, using a one-card bury/select-to-cemetery effect rather than mass bury.
